rationale: Overcollateralization, liquidation, public smart-contract state, and permissionless modules support quality and access, while shared backing, offchain exposures, oracle and governance dependence, and no ordinary claim to specific collateral constrain protection.

The January 21 independent report documents short Treasuries, overnight Treasury repo, cash, fixed deposits, full liability coverage, and segregated reserve accounts. The August 1 terms supply the later legal, redemption, and operational conditions; the interval therefore begins only when both sources were available.

The dated portfolio is mostly Treasury bills and cash with monthly attestations, but includes fixed deposits; access excludes retail and U.S. persons, reserves are beneficially issuer-owned, and stress suspension powers are broad.
Permitted reserves are cash and short government instruments in holder-benefit segregated accounts with monthly KPMG examinations; direct access still requires an eligible Paxos customer account.

The January 23 report independently examined short Treasury bills, government money-market funds, regulated-bank deposits, full liability coverage, holder-benefit accounts, and segregation. Public user terms dated October 3, 2024 establish redemption eligibility and suspension mechanics.

Short-duration reserve eligibility and monthly CPA attestations are strong; customer qualification, undisclosed public fee and SLA details, broad suspension powers, and the lack of a direct property interest reduce access and legal scores.
Highly liquid short-duration reserves, monthly assurance, and holder-benefit segregation are offset by institution-focused direct access and broad compliance and operational suspension rights.

Delta-neutral backing and off-exchange custody are observable through custodian attestations, but hedge, exchange, custodian, API, whitelist, cloud, liquidity, and execution dependencies remain material.

Overcollateralized and observable protocol backing plus a permissionless, zero-fee PSM route support conversion quality; shared and partly offchain collateral and governance, oracle, network, and liquidity dependencies remain.

A diversified consolidated reserve pool and quarterly assurance coexist with a $100,000 direct-redemption minimum, explicit fees, primary-customer limitations, and no established universal segregated holder claim.
